meta.name: aws-cloudformation-task-ecs-deploy-gh
meta.description: Provides patterns to deploy ECS tasks and services with GitHub Actions CI/CD. Use when building Docker images, pushing to ECR, updating ECS task definitions, deploying ECS services, integrating with CloudFormation stacks, configuring AWS OIDC authentication for GitHub Actions, and implementing production-ready container deployment pipelines. Supports ECS deployments with proper security (OIDC or IAM keys), multi-environment support, blue/green deployments, ECR private repositories with image scanning, and CloudFormation infrastructure updates.

copy.tagline: 用 GitHub Actions 自动化部署 ECS 任务和服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 AWS ECS 并想通过 GitHub Actions 实现自动化部署。
